description: Get a set of math practice problems WITHOUT their answers, chosen for this learner in one exam (grade): problems they missed come back first, and weak, heavily weighted topics get more problems. Returns each problem's id, topic, text and lettered options (1 to 20 per call, default 5). Optionally limit to one topic by its id from get_exam_overview. Read-only: nothing is recorded until check_answer. Each call may return a different set.

domain.description: Topic id to focus on, e.g. from get_exam_overview

exam.description: Exam (grade) id, e.g. "ca-d2" or "ca-t1". Leave out to use the grade the user saved (save_study_settings); get_exam_overview lists the ids.

name: practice_questions
title: Get practice questions
